listing.name: Yoshi (YoshiNESRecomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for YoshiNESRecomp; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream believes single-player, versus and demo playable, while calling it an unfinished preview. Latest startup checks are not a complete mechanics audit. In-development preview despite upstream belief fully playable. Latest header/startup replay evidence is not complete mechanics qualification. Upstream platforms: Windows VS2022/CMake build; native Linux x86-64 recheck documented. Other platform/architecture coverage Unknown. Original data: NES Yoshi USA matching program data, qualified cartridge/header and regional timing. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
